Coram : K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN*, A.K. SIKRI*
CONSTITUTION OF IND/A, 1950: A B Article 14 - Transgenders • Claim for equal treatment - C Held: Article 14 states that the State shall not deny to "any person" equality before law or equal protection of laws within the territory of India - Article 14 does not restrict the word male or female - Hijras/ transgender persons who are neither male nor female fall o within the expressions 'person' and hence entitle to legal protection of laws in all spheres of state activity including employment, healthcare, education as well as equal civil and citizenship rights as enjoyed
Decision Date : 15-04-2014 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 400/2012 | Disposal Nature : Case Allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
